title: lbmc: add UME ranged retransmission request dissection for UM 6.17
description:
Added dissection support for LBMC_NHDR_UME_RANGED_RXREQ (0x1F) introduced in Ultra Messaging 6.17.

This message type allows receivers to request a range of sequence numbers in a single retransmission request, used for late-join and off-transport recovery scenarios. More efficient than issuing individual retransmission requests for each lost message.

Structure dissected (12 bytes):

- next_hdr, hdr_len, flags (ignore bit)
- first_seqnum - start of requested sequence range
- last_seqnum - end of requested sequence range

Display filters:

- lbmc.ume_ranged_rxreq
- lbmc.ume_ranged_rxreq.first_seqnum
- lbmc.ume_ranged_rxreq.last_seqnum

Related capability flag (already present in dissector):

- lbmc.ume_capability.flags.ranged_rx_flag (0x1000)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 noreply@anthropic.com
